GlassLingomacOS 26.4+ · Preparing for release

Translate part of your screen

A Mac lens that reads and translates text that is hard to select on screen. The first free release supports English to Korean and Korean to English.

SupportPrivacy Policy ↗

INSIDE GLASSLINGO

Made for your everyday workflow.

01

Read the area you need

Place the lens over text that is hard to select in an image, PDF, or app. Resize it and release the handle to read the text and overlay a translation where it appears.

02

English and Korean, both ways

The first free release supports English to Korean and Korean to English. Swap the source and target, then copy recognized text or the translation. Availability depends on Apple’s language-pair support and the models installed on your Mac.

03

Processed on your Mac

Apple Vision and Apple Translation handle screen reading and standard translation on device. Requires macOS 26.4 or later and Screen Recording permission. Preparing language models may require an internet connection.
